description: This Java class is a property editor for ProgramWorkflow objects, enabling serialization and deserialization based on IDs and UUIDs within the OpenMRS framework, primarily used to facilitate data binding in web forms.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowEditor
classes.description: A property editor for converting between String representations (IDs and UUIDs) and ProgramWorkflow objects in OpenMRS.

methods.name: ProgramWorkflowEditor
methods.description: Default constructor for the ProgramWorkflowEditor class.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow object based on its integer ID using the ProgramWorkflowService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow object based on its UUID string using the ProgramWorkflowService.
